selection_rule: Choose the first enabled native domain (VERT, then EDGE, then FACE); author its all/odd/none selection, then close incidence and native flush.
history_rule: Use no history, selected native components in creation order, or that order reversed. Do not synthesize an active component when the selected set is empty.
initial_binding_requirements: literal scene adapter, complete initial state, exact declared selection/history, source quantized normals, data providers and outside data
remaining_before_freeze: immutable registry/capture/checker seal before complete native execution
separate frozen capacity workload and actual source results before Rust
coverage_scope: all expanded two-factor assignments; named full three-factor products; full hidden mode/selection/context/history product; retained analytic and scalar/native probes; not all Cartesian combinations or all float values
